Ada (Docs): Quick announcement: we're deprecating the old header-based tenant routing for docs links. New pattern uses /tenant/<id>/docs paths. Timeline: banner now, 45 days redirect, 45 days later 410. Please review migration examples.
Ben (SDK): Is this going to break any SDK-referenced docs links in examples? I can sweep repos for /?tenant= query strings.
Carmen (Product): Most examples updated in the docs repo; community quickstarts might still have query param usage. We should add a short codemod and a PR template note.
Ada (Docs): Migration snippet added: replace `https://docs.redwood.com/?tenant=acme` -> `https://docs.redwood.com/tenant/acme/docs`. Also adding server-side redirect rules.
infra-bot: Redirects deployed to CDN edge: rule set #77 applied. Canary: 1000 requests sampled.
Ben (SDK): I'll open js-sdk#520 to update examples and add a grep-based check in the CI to catch old patterns.
support-bot: KB task created for Support to handle incoming user reports.
Carmen (Product): Privacy/security note: tenant id in path is hashed for public links; internal admin links remain un-hashed. Docs call this out.
Ada (Docs): Post-deploy: redirect logs look good, samples updated in main docs. We'll monitor for any 404 spikes. Closing thread; ping here if you find missed links.
